independence: 381 expected IDs derived from fixed source declarations/helpers and reconciled against fixed-JAR models; current guide definitions used only in explicitly labeled snapshot

componentSensitiveExamples.reason: encoded machine configuration versus empty; preserve target type/name and copied settings
empty/encoded/invalid formula and stored ingredient ItemStacks are different states
installed modules and module options change abilities; do not normalize to a new empty stack
skins are data on one real robit ID; robit_allay is auxiliary model, not an item

Frequency-linked item colors use this component via IColoredItem; logistical-transporter routing color is separately stored on its transmitter BE, not a separate colored item registry ID. Do not assume transmitter color survives as an item component.
stored chemical identity/amount changes use; fluid storage is a separate component
frequency identity and visibility/owner must be preserved
frequency/owner and charge change destination availability
boxed block and block entity data versus empty box
stored item components distinguish HashedItems; also preserve drive_metadata

factoryRationale: Factory lesson explicitly uses an Enriching Factory as a model of common parallel slots, sorting and upgrades. Each of the nine FactoryType values additionally reaches its real processing lesson, or a specific compressor/combiner/sawmill Shift explanation; no claim that all factories run enrichment recipes. Fixed FactoryType and FactoryTier enums define the independent 9 x 4 universe.
processingRationale: Exactly seven PrimaryResource metals share the five verified intermediate conversions below. Iron is the explicitly named example in unchanged lessons, not a claim that every metal has identical recipes. Fluorite, gems, nonmetals and dirty netherite scrap are excluded from these aliases. Current pack recipes take precedence.
nativeExplanationPolicy: Original Mekanism Shift+N description and Shift details are preserved. All otherwise unexplained usable items get our ordinary Shift explanation. 31 module descriptions are already always visible and Shift lists supported/conflicting modules; four upgrades explain their distinct function with the native Shift details key. These third-party texts are not counted as our 22-language additions.

variantGroups.explanation: Transporter routing color is placed BE state; stack color/skin/module/contents variants retain complete ItemStack data
